channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: NYLIM's Hermann Says Bond Market Signals Tighter Rates
item.description: Julia Hermann, Global Market Strategist at New York Life Investment Management, says the recent move in bonds is warning equity investors to pay closer attention to interest rates. In her view, markets are heading into a tighter rates environment over the next few months, but the key question is whether the pressure comes from the front end of the curve through an imminent Fed tightening cycle or from the long end through further Treasury selloff and higher long-term yields. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AWS Invests in AI Entertainment
item.description: Amazon Web Services is working with Amazon MGM Studios on a major new initiative at the intersection of AI and entertainment: A gen AI film fund and a new AI production platform for participating up-and-coming filmmakers. AWS General Manager, Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports Samira Bakhtiar discusses the imitative and how the company is pioneering a new era of mobile entertainment in order to tap into more Gen Z viewers. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: T. Rowe Price's Jodi Love Discusses Active Small & Mid-Cap ETFs
item.description: Jodi Love, Lead Portfolio Manager for T. Rowe Price’s Active Small and Mid-Cap ETF lineup, joins Romaine Bostick live on-site at the T. Rowe Price Headquarters in Baltimore, MD. Love notes that these funds are a frequent topic of client questions. She goes on to highlight that T. Rowe Price’s active ETFs have just crossed a three-year benchmark. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Dell Sees Surge in AI Server Sales, Boosts Outlook
item.description: Dell Technologies Inc. shares jumped in extended trading after the company boosted its annual sales forecast by $25 billion due to surging demand for servers to run artificial intelligence tasks. Michael Monaghan, partner and portfolio manager for Founder Etfs, says Dell dominates the supply chain and keeps innovating. He joins "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Dropbox User Accounts Breached by Hackers Who Accessed Data
item.description: Hackers broke into thousands of Dropbox Inc. accounts last month, viewing and downloading material users kept on the cloud-storage platform, according to a company statement and records seen by Bloomberg News.
item.dc:creator: Jake Bleiberg

item.title: Apple Sets Pay Targets at $58 Million for Ternus, $47 Million for Cook
item.description: Apple Inc. said that new Chief Executive Officer John Ternus will get a compensation package worth about $58 million in fiscal 2027, while Tim Cook’s role as executive chairman will pay around $47 million.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Morehead Calls Bessent 'Bluff,' Strategy CEO Buys Again | Bloomberg Crypto 9/1/2026
item.description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Pantera Capital Founder & Managing Partner Dan Morehead, Strategy President & CIO Phong Le, and The Solana Foundation Head of Payments Growth Amira Valliani. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nokia to Rejoin Euro Stoxx 50 Index as Volkswagen Loses Its Spot
item.description: Nokia Oyj is regaining its spot in the euro area’s main stock benchmark as Volkswagen AG loses its place in the latest sign of the difficulties facing the region’s automotive industry.
item.dc:creator: Isolde MacDonogh and Jan-Patrick Barnert

item.title: Dell Raises Outlook as AI Server Revenue Surges | Closing Bell
item.description: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Kristine Aquino, and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Tops Profit Outlook on AI Security Demand
item.description: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. issued a profit outlook for the year that exceeded Wall Street’s expectations, fueled by corporate demand for stronger defenses against advancing artificial intelligence systems.
item.dc:creator: Ignacio Gonzalez

item.title: Apple Maps Renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ After Trump Order
item.description: Apple Inc. renamed Lake Ontario “Lake America” on its maps service, following a similar move by Alphabet Inc.’s Google, in the wake of an order from US President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Dell Boosts Annual Sales Forecast by $25 Billion; Shares Rise
item.description: Dell Technologies Inc. shares jumped in extended trading after the company boosted its annual sales forecast by $25 billion in a further sign of surging demand for servers to run artificial intelligence tasks.
item.dc:creator: Dina Bass

item.title: OpenAI Will Limit Access to New Astra Model’s Cybersecurity Features
item.description: OpenAI plans to soon roll out a powerful new artificial intelligence model called Astra, but said it will limit who can use the software’s most cutting-edge cybersecurity capabilities.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Metz

item.title: Florida Bans Flock Cameras, License Plate Readers From State Roads
item.description: Florida banned local police from installing license-plate readers on state roads, responding to growing concern about the proliferation of surveillance cameras made by Flock Safety and other companies.
item.dc:creator: Michael Smith

item.title: Strategy Has A 'Fortress Balance Sheet': CEO
item.description: Phong Le, CEO and president of Strategy, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Strategy resumed Bitcoin purchases after a 10-week pause, returning to its signature accumulation strategy after the crypto bear market pressured its shares, weakened confidence in the financing model and prompted a balance-sheet overhaul. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bessent's 'Bluff' 'Backfired': Pantera's Morehead
item.description: "The only way a bluff works is if nobody at the poker table knows you are bluffing, and to slide an extra $2 billion of poker chips out onto the table...when you are a forced seller...it backfired." Dan Morehead talks about Bessent's bond plan. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: LSE to Roll Out Tokenized Stocks
item.description: Amira Valliani, head of payments growth at The Solana Foundation, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." The London Stock Exchange is planning to launch tokenized stocks, backed by shares of London-listed companies, as it looks to further embrace digital assets. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Hyperliquid In Talks For US Market Entry
item.description: Bloomberg Intelligence's Dushyant Shahrawat joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Hyperliquid is in advanced talks to bring its perpetual futures to US traders through Kraken’s parent company Payward, just weeks after President Trump said his administration was working to bring the fast-growing platform into the US. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Sold 'Minuscule' Amount of Bitcoin: Strategy CEO
item.description: Phong Le, CEO and president of Strategy, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Strategy resumed Bitcoin purchases after a 10-week pause, returning to its signature accumulation strategy after the crypto bear market pressured its shares, weakened confidence in the financing model and prompted a balance-sheet overhaul. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Felix Pago Raises $200 Million to Expand Financial Services
item.description: Money-transfer startup Felix Pago raised $200 million to expand beyond remittances and offer services such as lending and savings to Latin American immigrants in the US.
item.dc:creator: Maria Clara Cobo
